thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER -> oncall (jess). High streaming error rate for tenant 'omnibank' on vpc-gateway-prod. Symptoms: WS timeouts, 502s on chunked streaming, sustained client retries. Detected 10x baseline error rate since 2026-03-15T10:02:00Z. Pager ID 7834.

jess (oncall): acked — I'm on it. tagging runtime + platform.

sara (eng-runtime): looking at metrics now. OmniBank has an abnormal number of half-open websocket connections and write backpressure. backlog per connection avg=420 frames, p95 write-latency=1.2s. Dedicated pool 'dedicated-pool-4' serving them is saturated on max-concurrent-streams.

mike (eng-platform): do we see retries from the customer side causing head-of-line blocking?

sara (eng-runtime): yes — logs show repeated immediate reconnects from the same client IP block. client_retry loops + gateway not honoring pings -> sockets kept alive in CLOSE_WAIT. sample log: 
```
2026-03-15T10:02:05Z [gateway/ws] tenant=omnibank conn_id=0x7f4 write_error=EPIPE backlog=768 max_streams=256
2026-03-15T10:02:07Z [gateway/ws] tenant=omnibank conn_id=0x8a2 receive_retry=1 origin=10.23.44.12
2026-03-15T10:02:09Z [runtime/kvs] tenant=omnibank kv_cache_hit=0.92
```

eli (eng-sre): sounds like tenant-level resource exhaustion. this is customer-specific (private VPC via gateway), so we should prefer tenant isolation mitigations before cluster-wide changes.

mike (eng-platform): immediate mitigations I can apply now: 1) set per-tenant concurrent stream limit lower to shed load, 2) enable http-chunked fallback for omnibank (forces long-poll chunking instead of WS), 3) move tenant to spare dedicated pool in us-east if connectivity allows. propose doing 1+2 immediately.

jess (oncall): do it. add blunt-rate-limit so retries don't thrash the pool. priority: reduce customer impact, avoid affecting other tenants.

sara (eng-runtime): recommended commands (applying now):
```
# reduce concurrent streams for tenant (applies at routing layer)
rctl tenant set-stream-limit omnibank 30

# enable HTTP chunked fallback (runtime will downgrade WS -> chunked HTTP)
rctl tenant set-streaming-fallback omnibank true

# temporarily increase guard-window for other tenants to free resources
rctl cluster set-tenant-safety 0.85
```

mike (eng-platform): executing 1/2 now. patching routing policy...

incident-bot: action-log: rctl tenant set-stream-limit omnibank 30 (executed by mike) at 2026-03-15T10:04:12Z

mike (eng-platform): enabling streaming-fallback now.

incident-bot: action-log: rctl tenant set-streaming-fallback omnibank true (executed by mike) at 2026-03-15T10:04:45Z

sara (eng-runtime): after the change backlog dropped on most connections, p95 write-latency down to 320ms on observed sockets. but we still see elevated error rate for a subset of clients that keep reconnecting. suggests client gateway behavior is contributing.

eli (eng-sre): okay, next steps: 1) platform to prepare pool migration plan (move to dedicated-pool-8), 2) eng-runtime to add short-lived per-tenant circuit-breaker (fail-open after X errors with fast exponential backoff) so we prevent thrash, 3) support to notify OmniBank SRE with suggested client-side fixes.

mike (eng-platform): I can do staged migration but note: OmniBank is on a VPC peering route — we need their ok for IP reroute. I'll draft a controlled failover plan and ETA.

support-ops: drafting customer message now. proposed content: 
"OmniBank SRE — we observed sustained websocket timeouts from your app gateway into our VPC integration. We've applied temporary mitigations (per-tenant stream limits and HTTP fallback) to reduce service disruption while we investigate root cause. We recommend: 1) disable aggressive immediate reconnects, 2) respect server pings/keepalive, 3) share gateway logs for 10:00-10:10 UTC. If you can accept a planned failover to our spare pool in us-east for 30m we can execute faster"

jess (oncall): please send that now, mark as SRE-urgent and include a call if needed. also open a Sev2 incident in ops tracker with links to logs and runbooks.

incident-bot: incident severity set to SEV2 by jess at 2026-03-15T10:06:30Z

mike (eng-platform): created migration playbook in platform-runbooks: /runbooks/omnibank-failover-2026-03-15. prepping the route move; will need oncall approval before cut. ETA 20m if customer approves.

eli (eng-sre): for the handoff: jess -> mike (platform) for migration, sara -> runtime for circuit-breaker and postmortem logs, support-ops -> customer comms. tagging oncall for next shift at 10:20 UTC for visibility.

sara (eng-runtime): adding extra debug logging for tenant streams (will auto-rotate after 1h). snippet: 
```
# runtime debug toggle
runtimectl debug tenant omnibank streams true --ttl 1h
```

jess (oncall): good. I'm going to hand this off at 10:20 to the next oncall. current impact: degraded streaming for OmniBank customers; interactive non-streaming API calls stable. mitigation in place reduces P50/P95, residual errors affecting ~3% of requests.

support-ops: outbound to customer sent at 2026-03-15T10:07:05Z, included request for logs and approval for failover.

mike (eng-platform): awaiting customer approval for failover. continuing monitoring.

eli (eng-sre): if customer declines failover, we should be ready to throttle by IP-block for worst offenders and escalate to legal if they are causing multi-tenant risk. prefer coordination first.

jess (oncall): thanks team. handoff to next oncall @10:20. I'll include links to action logs and runbook in the handoff.

incident-bot: routed handoff -> next-oncall at 2026-03-15T10:20:00Z.

mike (eng-platform): note for postmortem: add section on tenant-level backpressure counters and a runbook entry for 'gateway-induced reconnect storms'.

sara (eng-runtime): agreed — also include guidance for customers using long-lived WS over private gateways: recommend exponential backoff, proper keepalive/ping handling, and max reconnect rate.

jess (oncall): closing active paging for now — monitor to ensure error rate remains below alert threshold. will reopen if regression. :white_check_mark:
